answer: An admission auction blocks bulk fakes: 200 slots open per epoch, one sealed bid per applicant. Honest agents wander between jobs once admitted, one bid buying one slot locked 20 epochs. Clones cannot echo the same bid: each pays the 50 POA clearing price, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 POA, more than the reward they could split. A lantern registry lists every bid, so bought slots show at once. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
